Read through the materials below, and don’t hesitate to reach out and set up your consultation to learn more about what we can do for you. CareCredit is a company that provides patients with credit for their elective procedures, offering short-term, 0% interest payment plans and low-interest, extended payment plans. CareCredit has no up-front costs, no fees and no pre-payment penalties.
